title: Round record contract
description: One JSON line per round of the method, appended to state/round-record.jsonl. The rubric_hash ties the round to the frozen sha256 of the 'Rubric' section the verdict applied to; the verdict enum mirrors the mechanical rule of that section (rejected, accepted with conditions, accepted).

method_version.description: Semantic version of the method this round ran under.

summary.description: What the round did, one line.
